rhat.context: rank-normalized split/folded R-hat; final substantive inference
rhat.exceptions: Constant or deterministic quantities may give undefined values. Rough exploratory fits are not adequate for reporting; small R-hat alone does not establish mixing.

chains.context: independently initialized MCMC chains; not artificial splits of one run
chains.exceptions: Computational cost can constrain chain count; disclose the weaker between-chain assessment. Artificial chains do not validate an approximation.

ess.context: total bulk and tail ESS screening floor = 100 times chain count; MCSE can require much more
ess.meaning: pooled bulk/tail screening floor per chain count
ess.exceptions: Extreme quantiles, rare events and stringent scientific precision can require much larger ESS. Antithetic draws can give ESS above the nominal count.

divergences.context: HMC accuracy warning; zero does not prove correctness
divergences.exceptions: Zero divergences does not establish good mixing; even a few can matter, and their count alone does not quantify bias.

bfmi.context: per-chain HMC diagnostic; empirical warning rather than universal theorem
bfmi.exceptions: Empirical HMC warning only; inspect geometry and energy plots above the boundary too. Not a generic sampler diagnostic.

pareto_k.context: S is nominal posterior draw count used by package; examine low MCMC efficiency too
pareto_k.exceptions: Nominal draw count can make the screen optimistic when MCMC efficiency is poor. Low k does not establish model adequacy; high-k repairs need rechecking.

power_sensitivity.context: CJS-based local sensitivity gradient, not raw CJS distance; importance reliability checked separately
power_sensitivity.exceptions: Intended informative priors may legitimately be influential. Local powering cannot change prior support; selected factors/measure/quantity affect the interpretation.

elpd_small.context: descriptive book heuristic for total log ELPD; sample size, target, SE and scientific utility override; never a selection rule
elpd_small.meaning: book descriptive small total ELPD difference
elpd_small.exceptions: Not invariant to sample size, score scale or scientific utility. Difference uncertainty and candidate adequacy override the heuristic.

large_data_start.context: book starting example, not guaranteed sufficient; grow by subsampling uncertainty and influential strata
large_data_start.exceptions: Rare influential units, groups or dependence may require a different design or more observations; a pilot is not a precision guarantee.

mcse.context: require numerical error small against estimand-specific scientific tolerance; compare quantile MCSE for interval endpoints
mcse.meaning: estimand-specific numerical precision budget; no universal cutoff
mcse.exceptions: Undefined or infinite moments invalidate a mean/SD precision target. Use valid quantiles or revise the intended estimand.

comparison_small_n.context: current comparison normal-approximation diagnostic; small-N flag is not a selection or validity theorem
comparison_small_n.exceptions: Package caution is not a theorem or an automatic prohibition; assess skewness, dependence and evaluation-unit information.

priorsense_mm_trigger.context: default algorithm trigger in powerscale_sensitivity, not the general PSIS trust threshold; inspect actual installed defaults
priorsense_mm_trigger.exceptions: Adapter and package-version defaults differ. This is an algorithm trigger rather than a universal importance-sampling trust threshold.

pareto_moment_boundary.meaning: Pareto-tail model reaches failure of raw importance-ratio first moment
pareto_moment_boundary.context: Tail approximation; estimated k is uncertain and diagnoses importance ratios, not posterior parameter moments
pareto_moment_boundary.exceptions: Finite-sample k estimates do not establish exact true tail behavior; still do not trust high-k PSIS
